definitions.explanation: A strip of cloth used to wrap and protect wounds.

examples.japanese: {傷|きず}に{包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}いた。
examples.english: I wrapped a bandage around the wound.

examples.japanese: {包帯|ほうたい}を{取|と}り{替|か}える。
{腕|うで}に{包帯|ほうたい}をしている。
examples.english: I have a bandage on my arm.

notes:
{包帯|ほうたい} refers to cloth bandages wrapped around wounds, not adhesive strips.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}く: to wrap a bandage
- {包帯|ほうたい}を{取|と}り{替|か}える: to change a bandage
- {包帯|ほうたい}をほどく: to unwrap a bandage
- {包帯|ほうたい}をしている: to have a bandage on

TYPES:
- {弾性|だんせい}{包帯|ほうたい}: elastic bandage
- ガーゼ{包帯|ほうたい}: gauze bandage
- {三角|さんかく}{巾|きん}: triangular bandage (sling)

CONTRAST:
For adhesive bandages (band-aids), use {絆創膏|ばんそうこう} or バンドエイド.
